title: hello-voice — realtime audio in, one sentence out (target: voice)

beats.label: Open the starter README
beats.cue: “Speak a question, hear a one-sentence reply.” Audio in and out is the SDK's job.

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed crewhaus.yaml stays untouched.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — this target runs on OPENAI_API_KEY, not an Anthropic key.

verify.note: operator-supplied demos/.env; the voice target talks to the OpenAI Realtime API

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “Two lines: what it's called, and which runtime spine to compile.”

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: A realtime-capable model, and one hard rule: “one short sentence (≤ 25 words).”

beats.label: Add the voice block
beats.cue: Provider, TTS voice, server-side VAD — and barge-in: 4 speech frames inside 200 ms.

beats.label: Close with the permission floor
beats.cue: No tools in this spec — just a voice, so the default floor is the whole story.

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: Parse, then the IR passes the compile path skips — nothing emitted yet.

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The spec is sugar; this JSON is what the compiler actually sees.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target voice (provider, voiceId, vad, barge-in)

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: --check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it to its gate: GREEN.

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (3 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the --smoke pcm fixture gate

beats.label: Open the emitted config
beats.cue: The whole spec frozen into one const — and there are the two numbers: bargeInTriggerFrames 4, bargeInWindowMs 200.

beats.label: Open the emitted call loop
beats.cue: And here they are again, threaded straight into the barge-in controller — by name, never as a literal.

beats.label: Open the emitted daemon
beats.cue: Three TypeScript files — the config, the one-call loop, and the daemon that drives them. The fourth the compiler just counted is the bundle's own README.

beats.label: Boot the daemon with nothing
beats.cue: “v0 ships the headless smoke path” — it names the flag it wants and exits 2.

verify.note: deliberate non-zero: the emitted daemon requires --smoke <pcm-path>; the WebRTC + telephony bridge is a follow-up

beats.label: Make it a PCM fixture
beats.cue: 24 kHz, 16-bit, mono — one second of audio is exactly 48,000 bytes.

verify.note: one second of silence in the format every provider normalizes to

beats.label: Boot it with the fixture
beats.cue: Exactly the gate --check named — and it goes as far as the vendor lets it today: 24,000 samples loaded, socket opened, and OpenAI hangs up. “The Realtime Beta API is no longer supported.” The bundle is right; the adapter still sends the retired beta upgrade header, and exits 1 rather than pretend.

verify.note: non-zero today either way, so this is honestly offline: with OPENAI_API_KEY sourced the server rejects the `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` upgrade (@crewhaus/voice-runtime 0.4.0, src/index.ts:263) and the daemon exits 1 at `adapter is not connected`; with no key it exits 1 at the credentials gate. Re-cut this beat — and expectedExit — when voice-runtime moves to the GA /v1/realtime shape.

groups.title: One more thing · the smoke that's waiting on GA

beats.label: Open the repo's voice smoke
beats.cue: The test that will prove the whole loop: TTS synthesizes the question, streams it in, and asserts on session_created, transcript_final and ≥ 0.5s of agent audio. It runs the same daemon you just booted — so today it stops at the same beta-shape wall and exits 2. This is the beat that turns green the day the adapter moves to GA.

beats.label: Point at the one line in the way
beats.cue: One header on the upgrade request. That's the whole blocker — and it's in the vendored runtime the bundle just installed.

verify.note: the retired `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` upgrade header, in the copy `compile --check` installed into live/dist; the source is @crewhaus/voice-runtime src/index.ts:263
